Package hec.rss.plugins.opsupport.model

Class OsiIndependentVariable

java.lang.Object
hec.rss.model.IndependentVariable
hec.rss.plugins.opsupport.model.OsiIndependentVariable
All Implemented Interfaces:
AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, AltInputReportInfc, Serializable, Cloneable
public class OsiIndependentVariable extends IndependentVariable
The OsiIndependentVariable class extends the IndependentVariable class and adds specific functionality for handling observation-related variables. It introduces additional attributes to represent element type, observation time series name, and observation parameter name.

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a string representation of the object. If the type of this object is equal to the constant OBS_TYPE, the returned string describes the object in the format: "Obs Data for [observation time series name] - [observation parameter name]". Otherwise, delegates to the superclass's toString implementation.
      Overrides:
      toString in class IndependentVariable
      Returns:
      a string representation of the object. If the type is OBS_TYPE, it includes the observation time series name and parameter name; otherwise, it uses the superclass's string representation.
